title: Reporting Regulatory Mandates with the Subjunctive

sections.content: You know how to report personal orders and requests with *decir*, *pedir*, *ordenar* and *prohibir* + imperfect subjunctive from B1 Unit 38. In digital-governance reporting, the same structure expresses institutional mandates using *exigir que*, *ordenar que*, *pedir que* and *recomendar que* combined with passive *se* (*El marco regulatorio exige que se audite cada sistema*). The tense of the reporting verb sets the subjunctive tense: present reporting takes the present subjunctive (*la norma exige que se garantice la supervisión humana*), while past reporting shifts to the imperfect subjunctive (*el informe recomendó que se ampliara la ciberseguridad*).

sections.title: Reporting institutional mandates
rows: Standing rule (*El marco regulatorio exige que se audite todo algoritmo crítico.*)
Reported past ruling (*La autoridad ordenó que se reforzara la ciberseguridad.*)
Verb matches plural noun (*El comité pidió que se revisaran los protocolos.*)

items.spanish: El marco regulatorio exige que se audite cada modelo antes de su uso público.
items.english: The regulatory framework requires that every model be audited before public use.

items.spanish: La autoridad de control ordenó que se garantizara la supervisión humana en decisiones sensibles.
items.english: The oversight authority ordered that human oversight be guaranteed in sensitive decisions.

items.spanish: El informe técnico recomendó que se ampliaran las medidas de ciberseguridad y auditoría algorítmica.
items.english: The technical report recommended that cybersecurity and algorithmic-auditing measures be expanded.

items.spanish: La regulación tecnológica pide que las empresas informen con claridad sobre sus sistemas.
items.english: Tech regulation asks that companies report clearly on their systems.

sections.content: Check both tense sequence and plural agreement: after a past reporting verb (*ordenó*, *exigió*, *pidió*), shift to the imperfect subjunctive (*ordenó que se auditaran los sistemas*, not *se auditen* or *se auditaron*), and match the verb to a plural passive *se* subject.
